basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production fantasy MOBA walk animation sprite sheet. Create EXACTLY FOUR full-body poses of ONE identical character in a perfectly regular 2 columns by 2 rows grid, equal square cells, transparent background. Read order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right = walk cycle contact left foot forward, passing left foot under body, contact right foot forward, passing right foot under body. Feet visibly alternate; arms and held equipment subtly counter-swing. Every pose faces 3/4 front toward screen RIGHT, identical camera, costume, anatomy, scale and position. Extremely squat chibi EXACTLY 1.5 HEADS tall: crown-to-chin head is TWO THIRDS of crown-to-sole height, entire torso and stubby feet below chin only ONE THIRD. NO neck, tiny body, oversized expressive head, tiny mitten hands. Polished 2D hand-painted game art, dark silhouette outlines, clean cel shaded volumes, readable at 78px. Each full figure including weapons fits within central 84% of its own square cell, foot baseline at 90% cell height; align head and feet across frames, leave transparent margins. No ground shadows, pedestal, background, scenery, text, labels, borders, grid lines, watermark. Exactly 4 poses, no extra figures.
assembly: Concatenate basePrompt and promptSuffix for the exact generation prompt.
